name: Bitbucket Cloud
covers: Repositories, pull requests, comments, builds, Pipelines
credential: Atlassian API token with Bitbucket scopes, or an access token
credentialWhere: id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens → Create API token with scopes, or Repository, Project or Workspace settings → Access tokens
credentialNote: An API token is sent as Basic auth with the account's email address, which goes in email; an access token goes in accessToken and is sent as Bearer. In Bitbucket Pipelines, BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE and BITBUCKET_REPO_SLUG supply the workspace and repository when no toil setting does

supported.note: Bitbucket Cloud is always current. toil calls REST API 2.0 (https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0) with an Atlassian API token sent as Basic auth with the account email, or a workspace, project or repository access token sent as Bearer. Nothing has been run against a live workspace yet.
